system.description:
Take a Reload action to apply this ammo to any ranged weapon and place 4 tokens on this card.

Discard 1 token for each subsequent attack using that weapon. Targets get the Burning condition when hit and must Mark 1 Hit Point whenever they take an action until the GM Spends 1 Fear to remove the Burning condition.
